english.note: Use this specifically for cruel or unjust rule by a government or ruler, rather than oppression in general.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for cruel and unjust absolute rule.

examples.english: People cannot live peacefully under oppression.
examples.traditional: 人民喺暴政之下冇法過安穩日子。
examples.jyutping: jan4 man4 hai2 bou6 zing3 zi1 haa6 mou5 faat3 gwo3 on1 wan2 jat6 zi2

examples.english: Many people throughout history have suffered under tyranny.
examples.traditional: 歷史上好多人民都曾經飽受暴政之苦。
examples.jyutping: lik6 si2 soeng6 hou2 do1 jan4 man4 dou1 cang4 ging1 baau2 sau6 bou6 zing3 zi1 fu2
